svg.title: Zebrafish
svg.desc: Adult zebrafish in lateral view with alternating dark and pale horizontal stripes, transparent fins, operculum, and forked tail. Biological basis: Zebrafish combine vertebrate organ systems with external fertilization, rapid development, optical access in larvae, and strong genetic tractability.
